description: These brown butter chocolate chip cookies have the BEST flavor. Nutty, rich, thick, and chewy with crispy edges 🤎 Ingredients 	•	1 cup unsalted butter 	•	1 cup brown sugar 	•	1/2 cup granulated sugar 	•	1 egg + 2 egg yolks 	•	2 tsp vanilla 	•	2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour 	•	1 tsp baking soda 	•	1 tsp salt 	•	1 1/2 cups chocolate chips Quick Steps 	1.	Brown butter until nutty, cool until solid 	2.	Cream butter + sugars 	3.	Mix in egg, yolks & vanilla 	4.	Fold in dry ingredients + chocolate 	5.	Scoop & bake Bake: 	•	375°F for 9–10 min (no chill) 	•	OR freeze 20 min → 375°F for 11–12 min 	•	OR chill 2 hrs → 350°F for 15 min For the full recipe 👉 Google “Lifestyle of a Foodie brown butter cookies” #cookietok #brownbutter #chocolatechipcookies #bakingtok #easycookies
transcript: You know those $7 bakery cookies you can't walk past? Well, this is that cookie. And I never once let these cool down before eating like three of them. They're made with a brown butter cookie dough base and then the bakery secret here is to use either chopped chocolate bars or giant cookie chips for those puddles of chocolate. Trust me, once you make these, you're never going back.
